excerpt.zh: 我们收到了报告，是关于在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上进行超光速航天器推进装置的事项。当地居民似乎打算成为一个彻底的太空文明。然而，他们在星空中发现的东西，可能会证明当下阶段他们还无法理解。
excerpt.en: We have received reports of superluminal spacecraft propulsion on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. The inhabitants seem intent on becoming a full-fledged spacefaring civilization. What they discover in the stars may prove too much for them to comprehend.

scope.zh: 分派事件1495与1500–1520的完整分支，含退回旧时代与进入太空。
scope.en: Dispatcher 1495 and the full 1500-1520 branch, including regression and reaching FTL.

texts.zh: 我们收到了报告，是关于在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上进行超光速航天器推进装置的事项。当地居民似乎打算成为一个彻底的太空文明。然而，他们在星空中发现的东西，可能会证明当下阶段他们还无法理解。
texts.en: We have received reports of superluminal spacecraft propulsion on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. The inhabitants seem intent on becoming a full-fledged spacefaring civilization. What they discover in the stars may prove too much for them to comprehend.

title.zh: 获得很多，但是失去的更多
title.en: Much To Gain, Yet Much to Lose

texts.zh:
现已证实，[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]确有一艘理论上存在超光速能力的飞船。他们已经开始进行测试，以期尽快突破光障。

一旦成功，他们在技术上便已具备涉及星系外交的能力。这样的境遇必然对他们的社会造成或好或坏的深远影响。
texts.en:
The existence of a theoretically FTL-capable craft on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] is now confirmed. They have moved on to testing, hoping to soon break the light speed barrier.

If they are successful, they will technically be ready to engage in galactic diplomacy. Such an encounter is sure to have profound effects on their society, for good or ill.

label.zh: 他们必须自力更生。保持距离进行观测。
label.en: They must learn on their own. Observe from a distance.

label.zh: 他们还没准备好。破坏他们的任务。
label.en: They're not ready. Sabotage their mission.

label.zh: 改变我们的应对方案。帮助他们触及星辰！
label.en: Change our approach. Help them reach the stars!

label.zh: 我们开始厌烦了。让他们在自己的道路上快马加鞭。
label.en: We grow weary. Speed them along on their way.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上雄心勃勃的宇航员们试图突破光障。整个星球的目光都聚焦在这艘飞船向着星间启航。

发射成功了。一切都按预期的参数运行中。随后他们启动了曲速引擎，事情发生了转折。

他们成功地扭曲了时空连续统（这是一种迷人但存在缺陷的超光速航行方式），然而他们只在舰船尾部成功了。随之而来的在案超乎了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的一切想象。乘员们被剧烈地扭曲撕扯，身体的一部分停留于原地，而同时另一部分被扯入了未来。

他们可得再多花一些时间才能进行下一次尝试了。
texts.en:
The aspiring spacefarers on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] attempted to break the light speed barrier. The whole world looked on as the spacecraft launched towards the stars.

Liftoff was a success. Everything was operating within expected parameters. Then they engaged their warp drive and things took a turn.

They successfully distorted the shape of the space-time continuum (a fascinating but flawed approach to breaking the light speed barrier), however they were only successful in doing this in the aft section of the craft. The resulting carnage was beyond anything the inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] could have ever imagined. The crew was violently distorted, fixed in one part of space, whilst simultaneously having other parts of themselves stretched into the future.

It could be some time before they are ready for a second attempt.

label.zh: 要是我们早点警告他们，他们现在早就成为太空文明了……
label.en: Had we warned them, they would be spacefarers now...

tooltips.zh: 他们的科技退步了，结果让他们倒车回到了前一个发展阶段。
tooltips.en: Their technology has regressed, effectively knocking them back to an earlier age in their development.

label.zh: 如期而至。他们的失败是不可避免的。
label.en: As expected. Their failure was inevitable.

tooltips.zh: 他们的科技退步了，结果让他们倒车回到了前一个发展阶段。
tooltips.en: Their technology has regressed, effectively knocking them back to an earlier age in their development.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们在实验性跃迁引擎方面取得了巨大的成功，然而他们在关于时空扭曲产生器的投射距离计算方面犯了严重的错误。通过与他们的直接沟通，我们得以引导他们通过超空间航道这种广为接受的方式来进行超光速航行。

依照我们的建议，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]很快就能加入我们的星系社会了。
texts.en:
The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have made remarkable progress on their experimental jump drive, however there were some glaring mistakes in their calculations relating to the projected range of their space-time distortion generator. By engaging in direct communication, we were able to guide them towards the accepted method of faster than light travel via hyperlane network.

Following our advice, [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will soon join us as a galactic spacefaring society.

label.zh: 我们静候他们的到达，加入更广泛的星海共同体。
label.en: We await their arrival into the wider galactic community.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的居民们作为一个宇航文明加入了星海共同体。

我们的观测任务结束了，他们已经拥有了超光速运行能力。
texts.en:
The inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have joined the wider galactic community as a spacefaring society!

Our observation mission now concludes, as they are now FTL capable.

tooltips.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will advance to their next technological age.

label.zh: 他们不挡我们的路就是做了好事。
label.en: They would do well to stay out of our way.

tooltips.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will advance to their next technological age.

summary.text:
# 推进力学支持者宣言 / Propulsion Proponent Proclamation

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:4228-4704`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）；`common/scripted_effects/pre_ftl_scripted_effects.txt:3087`（achieve_ftl_effect）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 25。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 25.
- 条件：早期太空时代，以被动观察或样本采集任务观测；未禁用毁灭性前超光速事件；同一观测国只发生一次；与“行星际飞行”互斥（后者会设置本事件的标记）。
  Conditions: Early Space Age observed with Passive Observation or Specimen Collection; devastating pre-FTL events not blocked; once per observing empire; exclusive with "Interplanetary Flight" (which sets this event's flag).
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1500「推进力学支持者宣言」：他们宣布研制超光速推进 → 500 天后 1505「获得很多，但是失去的更多」。
  1500 "Propulsion Proponent Proclamation": they announce superluminal propulsion → 500 days later 1505 "Much To Gain, Yet Much to Lose".
- 1505：（重视他者）远观，或（不重视他者）破坏试验 → 1000 天后 1510「完全脱离」：曲速试验失败，他们的科技倒退回更早的时代（重新开始科技进步局势）。
  1505: (values others) observe from afar, or (does not) sabotage the test → 1000 days later 1510 "Complete Separation": the warp test fails and their technology regresses to an earlier age (the tech-progress situation restarts).
- 1505：（重视他者）帮助他们，或（不重视他者）加速他们 → 1000 天后 1515「步入太空文明」→ 再 1000 天 1520「在身边」：他们成为太空文明，观测任务结束。
  1505: (values others) help them, or (does not) speed them along → 1000 days later 1515 "Spacefaring Commences" → another 1000 days 1520 "Among Us": they join the galaxy as a spacefaring society and the observation mission ends.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 倒退（1510）与进入太空（1515→1520）互斥。1520 通过 achieve_ftl_effect 让该文明成为太空国家，并在 1 天后由 pre-FTL 年代故事中的 preftl.1111 通报。
  Regression (1510) and spaceflight (1515→1520) are exclusive. 1520 turns the civilization into a spacefaring country via achieve_ftl_effect, announced a day later by preftl.1111 in the pre-FTL ages story.
- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 1505、1510、1520 的选项措辞按是否重视他者成对出现，效果相同。
  The options of 1505, 1510 and 1520 come in pairs by whether the empire values others; effects match.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、全部延迟（500/1000/1000/1000 天）与分支。
  Checked: trigger, all delays (500/1000/1000/1000 days) and branches.
- 更正：1520 的“成为太空国家”效果内含起源开局效果（克隆大军、控制论信条等），编译器据此连到这些起源故事，属于假连接，已用 suppress 移除；保留到 preftl.1111 与科技进步局势的跨故事连接。
  Correction: the achieve-FTL effect in 1520 contains origin start-up effects (Clone Army, Cybernetic Creed…); the compiler linked them as continuations — false links now suppressed; the cross-story links to preftl.1111 and the tech-progress situation remain.
